notes: The Parcoursup page states tuition of 178 EUR/year only for French/EU students and says 'Pas de frais pour les boursiers' for scholarship holders; for non-EU applicants the Campus France Morocco page states the 'droits d'inscription différenciés' of 2 902 EUR for a Licence year, but that page is about public higher-education institutions generally and does not name this programme. A dedicated programme fee for non-EU applicants is therefore not stated; verify with the institution. The programme is taught in French (DUT/BUT in an IUT); no English-taught track is mentioned. National curriculum expectations ('Attendus nationaux') list competences but the subject quote above ('attention sur les matières : Maths, Physique, LV 1...') concerns how secondary-school results are weighted, not a strict requirement. The 2026 oral-exam dates (4-13 May 2026) are given on a general Parcoursup calendar, not specifically for non-EU applicants, and are left out of requirements. No application deadline for non-EU applicants is stated on these pages.

note.en: Oral exams may be organised for foreign applicants according to the Campus France calendar; check your country's space for dates.
